questions.question:
After interchanging the given two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively?

+ and -

I. 18 ÷ 3 + 6 × 2 - 8

II. 15 × 3 - 45 ÷ 5 + 30
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1a2f9ab33e780cba5010b6de702b28619de1d1b1c922808fce2123379d05d37.png] 

I. Given equation : 18 ÷ 3 + 6 × 2 - 8

After interchanging the given two symbols + and - the equation is as follows : 18 ÷ 3 - 6 × 2 + 8

= __**18 ÷ 3**__ - 6 × 2 + 8

= 6 - __**6 × 2**__ + 8

= __**6**__ - 12 __**+ 8**__

= __**14**____** - 12**__

= **2**

II. Given equation : 15 × 3 - 45 ÷ 5 + 30

After interchanging the given two symbols + and - the equation is as follows : 15 × 3 + 45 ÷ 5 - 30

= 15 × 3 + __**45 ÷ 5**__ - 30

= __**15 × 3**__ + 9 - 30

= __**45 + 9**__ - 30

= __**54 - 30**__

= **24**

Hence, the correct answer is **"2 and 24".**

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow (s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some nachos are patties.

Some patties are pastries.

No pastry is a chocolate.

**Conclusions:**

I. No nacho is a chocolate.

II. Some nachos are pastries.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Statements:

Some nachos are patties.

Some patties are pastries.

No pastry is a chocolate.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/297e20b5272008457e68a388163ccd132ed8adaa964ad61cc8cf495ef1ec8fb6.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No nacho is a chocolate. → **Not follow** (Because there is no direct relation between nacho and chocolate, so it can be possible but not definitely true)

II. Some nachos are pastries. → **Not follow** (Because there is no direct relation between nachos and pastries, so it can be possible but not definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion I nor II follows**".

questions.solution:

**Logic:** First word is the capital city of the second word.

 
• Hyderabad : Telangana → Telangana is the capital city of Hyderabad.

Similarly,

 
• Gangtok : ? → Gangtok is the capital city of Sikkim.

Hence, '**Sikkim**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

First row - 11, 19, 27

Second row - 17, 25, 33

Third row - 23, 31, ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **(First number + Third number) ÷ 2 = Second number

First row - 11, 19, 27 → (27 + 11) ÷ 2 = 38 ÷ 2 = 19

Second row - 17, 25, 33 → (17 + 33) ÷ 2 = 50 ÷ 2 = 25

Similarly,

Third row - 23, 31, ? → (23 + ?) ÷ 2 = 31

⇒ 23 + ? = 31 × 2

⇒ 23 + ? = 62

⇒ ? = 62 - 23

⇒ ? = 39

Hence, '**39**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Five men Ankit, Bishal, Chandler, Daksh and Joey are sitting at a horizontal table facing north. Ankit is to the immediate left of Daksh who is not at the corner. Joey is exactly in between Bishal and Chandler. Who is sitting at the leftmost end?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Five men Ankit, Bishal, Chandler, Daksh and Joey are sitting at a horizontal table facing north.

**Explanation : **

1) Ankit is to the immediate left of Daksh who is not at the corner.

As position of Daksh is not definite yet, therefore there are three possible position for Daksh.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e382c09f76bef7aa523b7acce70fd467d91cbf6754829220a4711321e39dded.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d4e7aa137a38a72d26b62b29c0dd71a1b44f53fcb52cde22b62749568efc0c8.png] 

 
• Case - (3) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bc6d4f97a09b29c3f5835132637d5db4ab0f19b700295a65aa3a966522f2101.png] 

2) Joey is exactly in between Bishal and Chandler.

As there is possible position for Joey with respect to Bishal and Chandler in case - (2) and case - (3), therefore both the cases are eliminated.

As position Bishal and Chandler with respect to Joey is not known yet, therefore there are two possible positions for both Bishal and Chandler.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/533c0ca04cb536e9082cf745b9d70f4bd7f1ab1fb92922915bc4b43690dd61e6.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Ankit is sitting at the leftmost end.

Hence, **"Ankit"** is the correct answer.
